title: benchmarks legacy (pre-org) cell manifest, schema version 1
description: legacy/<source>/<cell>/manifest.json: one cell imported byte for byte from a protocol repository's release tag, as it was published before the org's run format existed (ADR-0003). Not a run: runs/ manifests follow manifest.schema.json, and verdicts/ and the overview never read legacy/. tools/validate_run.py legacy enforces this file with the same stdlib interpreter, then checks it against the cell (sha256, ##PROV## commits and images, arms and seeds, defects, the #460 invalid entry). A field change bumps schema_version.

schema_version.description: This legacy manifest schema's version (independent of manifest.schema.json's).

provenance.description: Measured before the org's run format: never a current result (ADR-0003).

cell.description: The cell's name: the source file's name without .txt, and this directory's name.

family.description: The network family the cell belongs to, as the import named it (the file-name prefix).

source.description: Where the file was imported from: the release tag that published it and the commit the tag names. The cell is byte-identical to the file there.

tag.description: A release tag (vX.Y.Z), never a branch (ADR-0003).

measured.description: One entry per distinct commit the cell's ##PROV## lines name, in the order they first appear; empty only with a no-prov defect.

ref.description: The ref the run was dispatched from, as ##PROV## names it (often a branch: the measured commit need not be a release).

run_ids.description: The workflow run ids ##PROV## names for this commit.

contains_fix.description: Whether the commit descends from the #459 fix (swarm-routing/AntHocNet 1a7c32b9538d9a1d9449a00c114286ad49f64c93); 'unresolved' when neither git nor GitHub could say.

images.description: Every image ##PROV## names. A rolling tag carries its digest of record, read later (verified false); a digest ##PROV## names itself is verified.

role.description: run: the image the cell ran in; base: the image it was built FROM.

ref.description: The image as ##PROV## names it, without a digest.

verified.description: true: ##PROV## names this digest; false: the digest of record of a rolling tag, not proven to be the bytes the run used.

digest_source.description: For an unverified digest: where it was read (a blob at a pinned commit).

digest_read.description: For an unverified digest: the date the source read it from the registry.

arms.description: Each arm with ##RUN## rows and the seeds it ran, as found (golden rule 6 is recorded as a seeds-below-20 defect, never enforced by dropping data).

markers.description: The marker-line contract the cell is read under: a version in schemas/markers/.

defects.description: Every way the cell breaks the contract or the org rules, declared: the validator recomputes the list and requires it equal (an undeclared defect fails, and so does a stale one).

invalid.description: Markers whose numbers are invalid, with the issue that says why (maintainer decision on #7: imported and flagged, never dropped). Recomputed by the validator.

supersedes.description: What this newer record supersedes, carried by the newer record only (rule 10: nothing is edited forward). target: a legacy cell (legacy/<source>/<cell>) or a pinned page URL.

notes.description: Free text a reader needs that no field holds.
